verdict.rationale: Airweave hosts a working llms.txt at docs.airweave.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200, confirmed by probe) plus markdown-appendable docs pages explicitly designed for agent consumption, and also publishes official 'skills' for Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, etc. so agents can self-configure. missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation that an agent successfully used llms.txt end-to-end, and no evidence of additional agent-discovery standards (e.g. skills.json manifest validation).
